question: Pila ang bayad sa electrical inspection para sa mga standby generator ug transformer nga gipanag-iya sa edipisyo?
answer:
Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungod sa mga standby generator ug transformer nga gipanag-iya sa edipisyo.

However, for electrical inspection fees related to buildings, the following information can be found in the OCBD Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf [S2].

1. A one-time electrical inspection fee equivalent to 10% of Total Electrical Permit Fees shall be charged to cover all inspection trips during construction [S2, S3].

Unfortunately, the Charter does not provide specific fees for standby generators and transformers. It is recommended to contact the Office of the City Building Official (OCBO) for more detailed information.

ground_truth: Transformer, UPS, and generator capacity fees under Section 4.b are: 5 kVA or less = PHP 40.00; over 5 to 50 kVA = PHP 40 + PHP 4/kVA; over 50 to 300 kVA = PHP 220 + PHP 2/kVA; over 300 to 1,500 kVA = PHP 720 + PHP 1/kVA; over 6,000 kVA = PHP 4,170 + PHP 0.25/kVA.
